# rust-core fixtures — measured properties

**Generated, not written.** `fixtures/generate.sh` produced the files and
`fixtures/measure.mjs` read every number below off the bytes on disk. Stage project
text cites this file instead of quoting numbers (CONTRACT.md hard rule 6).

**Do not regenerate.** The committed bytes are the truth — see the warning at the top
of `generate.sh`. `reserved_space` in particular is a property of the sqlite3 binary
that wrote the file, not of the format.

- generated by: `/usr/bin/sqlite3` — 3.51.0 2025-06-12
- generated on: 2026-08-19
